notes.title: What have we been up to?
notes.notes:
It has been a very busy month for the team at Silent Yeti and we have accomplished a lot. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40118755/934c589b1093426b6f50a2c6d6180ba4205fbc8b.png[/img]
First of all, we submitted our last pieces of work for our final year at Wrexham Glyndŵr University. University was a great experience for all of us at Silent Yeti and it is responsible for the existence of A Couple Of Cubes, as it was our final year project. Throughout this past year we have seen some great response to our demo and have decided to fully commit ourselves to this project and see it through to a full release.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40118755/60b016a384601da6732368dd569bd270ccba4b50.png[/img]

Secondly, we have released a new demo! The new demo is far more representative of the game that we are creating and we hope it resonates with our audience the same way that the previous demo did. There is plenty more to come in terms of gameplay and cinematics, but the core ideas and feel of the game are ready for you to try out in our new demo. 

Let us know what you think through our twitter [url=https://twitter.com/SilentYetiGames]@SilentYetiGames[/url] or in the discussions section here on steam!

[h3]One more thing...[/h3]

Finally, we are incredibly excited to announce that A Couple Of Cubes has been selected to take part in the Tranzfuser 2021 Enterprise Pathway. This is something that the team has been preparing for all year and we are overjoyed and humbled to have been selected as 1 of 17 teams to take part.

[h2]What is Tranzfuser?[/h2]

[url=https://tranzfuser.com/]"Tranzfuser is all about boosting the UK’s future games development graduate talent."[/url] - Tranzfuser.com

Tranzfuser offers UK graduates the opportunity to develop their intellectual property (IP) with advice and assistance from industry veterans across the UK. At the end of Tranzfuser, teams are provided with the opportunity to pitch for funding to help with development costs of the team's IP.

[h3]Last Year's Winners Include:[/h3]
[url=https://twitter.com/wordplayteam]Word Play Games, with their game Days Lost[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/gamesbygrads]Offbrand Games, with Will it Golf?[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/ChimeraTales]Chimera Tales, and their game Hotel Arcanum[/url]
[url=https://twitter.com/borria]Knights of Borria, with Rustbreaker[/url]

You can follow Tranzfuser on Twitter [url=https://twitter.com/Tranzfuser]here.[/url]

[h2]Why Tranzfuser?[/h2]

Tranzfuser offers us a larger scope than would otherwise be possible for A Couple of Cubes. We are very passionate about A Couple of Cubes and will take every step we can to make a fun and successful game out of it. Taking part gives us the opportunity to network with some of the best in UK games talent and we are really excited to get started on full time work.

Lastly, we would like to thank Tranzfuser for giving us the opportunity to take part in the process.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40118755/28ab65ce407443194fa398161b968ff8a3af7a4a.jpg[/img]

As always, add A Couple of Cubes to your wishlist to follow along with the development. There's a lot more to come!

notes.title: Progress Update May 2021
notes.notes:
Thanks all for your interest in A Couple of Cubes! We really appreciate everyone's support in helping us create a better game and a stronger community. 

Developing A Couple of Cubes has been so much fun for the team and continues to inspire us in new ways every day. The possibilities are endless with our art style and mechanics and some of the things we have come up with are starting to get really exciting! You can see a teaser for one of our crazy set pieces below:

[previewyoutube=62bPy-HUIyo;full][/previewyoutube]

We're overjoyed to get the chance to work with the immensely talented Adventure Shop on this project and his music brings yet another level of quality to our riveting adventure of a game. 

We have had a lot of great feedback from our demo and it has really benefited the development as it has allowed us to understand what people love about the game. The team have implemented so many changes over the past couple of months that the game is almost completely redesigned from our initial demo. We are really happy with how the game is coming along and can't wait to share more!

If you'd like to follow along more closely with the development of the game, follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/SilentYetiGames]Twitter @SilentYetiGames.[/url]
